reference.truth_and_reconstruction: subtract the mean over observed non-mastoid channels after applying the declared drop set
reference.test_retest_floor: for each metric and drop set, compare Rest1 and Rest2 truth in that same drop-set-specific reference frame
reference.forbidden: full-montage truth floors compared with dropout-frame reconstruction errors

cnt.production_requirement: attach independent acquisition/header/byte-layout evidence before release

artifact_cleaning.ica_policy: forbidden in the primary Stage-0 path; any ICA-cleaned sensitivity must use a separate experiment ID and cache
artifact_cleaning.epoch_amplitude_policy: record flat or >300 uV peak-to-peak measurements by epoch and channel for descriptive QC only; do not classify channels, reject epochs, or reject recordings from these values
artifact_cleaning.continuous_channel_policy: record standard deviation, railing fraction, maximum amplitude, and maximum sample jump; only nonfinite samples are a processing error
artifact_cleaning.continuous_excursion_policy: record maximum amplitude and sample-jump warnings but do not reject a recording solely for excursions outside selected marker epochs
artifact_cleaning.rejected_annotations: exclude only source intervals explicitly marked bad and record each exclusion
artifact_cleaning.primary_truth_definition: source-annotation-accepted non-overlapping marker epochs after deterministic channel mapping, one bandpass, resampling, and edge crop; use available epochs up to the run's requested maximum and record requested, available, and selected counts

coordinates.input: MNE standard_1005 head coordinates in metres
coordinates.out_of_bounds_policy: replicate the pinned official tokenizer: warn conceptually, convert normalized coordinates to integer bins, and clamp bins to [0,99]; preserve original and componentwise-clipped coordinates
coordinates.collision_policy: fail if any active channels map to the same complete xyz token triplet
coordinates.verified_current_montage: nine of 62 channels saturate the z token at 99; all 62 complete xyz token triplets remain unique
coordinates.reason: official ZUNA usage directs standard_1005 montage attachment, while the pinned tokenizer explicitly clamps out-of-range discrete bins; the benchmark records this transform rather than applying an undocumented geometric rescale

strategy_definitions.median_survivor_std_zero_mean_carrier: per epoch, assign every target the median SD of all surviving channels
strategy_definitions.spatial_neighbor_robust_std_zero_mean_ca: per epoch and target, assign the median SD of the four nearest surviving channels in the frozen coordinate frame
strategy_definitions.observed_position_logstd_ridge_zero_mean: per epoch, fit log channel SD from surviving standardized xyz positions using intercept-unpenalized ridge with xyz penalty 0.1, then predict each target position
strategy_definitions.normalized_scale_free_output: store model target output divided by the blind carrier scale used for that target and epoch

zuna_scaling.forbidden: target waveform, target mean, target standard deviation, or target-informed strategy selection
zuna_scaling.release_requirement: store normalized and physical outputs and quantify all predeclared sensitivities

specparam_peaks.fit_diagnostics_policy: persist fit status, posterior-channel count, R-squared, mean absolute error, detected-peak count, and alpha-peak count without threshold-based exclusion

failure_policy.required: every expected unit appears exactly once with a terminal state
failure_policy.cohort_rule: failures remain in denominators and reports; they may not disappear from aggregation
failure_policy.selection_rule: held-out truth may quantify quality but may not silently select which units are analyzed
